title: Profile

title: Light Up The House
text: Light Up The House (featured project, 2026). Stack: Unreal Engine 5 (Blueprints & C++). Role: Solo / Lead Developer · Gameplay & Systems Programmer. Third-person sci-fi adventure aboard a dark, malfunctioning space shuttle where the player must restore a failed power grid before time runs out. Links: Trailer: https://youtu.be/SAdCzLdvwuI, Gameplay: https://youtu.be/IanUdZbedtk.

title: Light Up The House: contributions
text: What Faisal did on Light Up The House (Unreal Engine 5 (Blueprints & C++)): Core gameplay & logical structures: end-to-end game loop, countdown timer state machine, tool-to-appliance matching validation (Blueprints and C++). Navigation & spatial flow: multi-corridor shuttle layout, dark-environment sightlines, dynamic lighting from emergency blackout to full illumination. Player interaction systems: third-person interaction triggers, item pickup/equip logic, visual feedback cues for broken ship systems.

title: Ghost Lantern
text: Ghost Lantern (featured project, 2026). Stack: Three.js · JavaScript (full-stack web). Role: Solo · Full-Stack Game & Web Developer. Multi-level first-person 3D browser horror-survival game with raycast torch combat, four ghost AI archetypes, and full-stack OTP user accounts with a global leaderboard. Links: Play live: https://ghost-lantern-nine.vercel.app/.

title: Ghost Lantern: contributions
text: What Faisal did on Ghost Lantern (Three.js · JavaScript (full-stack web)): First-person atmospheric exploration: multi-room levels with dense fog and a directional spotlight torch. Raycast combat & resource management: continuous raycasting to banish ghosts while the battery drains; non-regenerating health. Four ghost AI archetypes: Tall, Fast, Horrific, and a Friendly blue ghost that penalizes the player if beamed. Authentication & global leaderboard: email OTP verification, persistent player dashboards, run tracking across both levels.

title: Chrono Rebellion
text: Chrono Rebellion (featured project, 2025). Stack: Unity · C#. Role: Team of 3 · Gameplay Programmer & Level Designer. First-person time-travel action shooter: a soldier from 2145 travels back to World War II to stop enemy forces armed with stolen alien technology. Links: Gameplay: https://youtu.be/FuWAgXPMjxw.

title: Chrono Rebellion: contributions
text: What Faisal did on Chrono Rebellion (Unity · C#): Concept & core combat scripting: co-created the concept; programmed player movement, aiming, and sci-fi weapon shooting in C#. Character animations & logic: combat and locomotion animation state transitions plus mission progression logic. Dual-era level setup: built and dressed scenes bridging the futuristic 2145 vessel and WWII combat zones.

title: Behind the Smile
text: Behind the Smile (featured project, 2025). Stack: Unity · C#. Role: Team of 6 · Asset Integration, Animation & UI Developer. A 48-hour Global Game Jam 2026 entry on the theme "Mask": an angel helps townspeople who hide their true emotions behind identical smiling masks. Links: Gameplay: https://youtu.be/tTceiBnP9YM.

title: Behind the Smile: contributions
text: What Faisal did on Behind the Smile (Unity · C#): Character & environment animations: animation states and expressive transitions triggered when masks are removed. UI systems & dialogue flow: narrative UI panels, dialogue prompts, scene transition overlays in Unity. 3D asset pipeline: prepared, imported and configured 3D town and character assets within the 48-hour deadline.

text: Mochi and the Royal Fish (featured project, 2026). Stack: Three.js · JavaScript. Role: Solo · Game & AI Programmer. Stylized 3D cat-and-dog stealth heist game demonstrating autonomous AI guard patrol, line-of-sight detection and tactical evasion. Links: Play live: https://mochi-heist.vercel.app/, Gameplay: https://youtu.be/1qQqhyVils8.

title: Mochi and the Royal Fish: contributions
text: What Faisal did on Mochi and the Royal Fish (Three.js · JavaScript): Autonomous palace guard AI: patrol pathing, state switching and live minimap tracking for the guards "Duke" and "Baron". Stealth & ability mechanics: Sneak (Shift), Dash (Space), Yarn distraction (E), Hide (Q), Catnip charge meters. Custom heist HUD & minimap: guard patrol status, minimap radar, round scoring, remaining fish targets.

title: About this website
text: This portfolio is an interactive 3D website built with Three.js and Vite and hosted on Vercel. It is a game-style cabin with board games: Ludo is About Me, chess is Skills (playable against an AI), the property board is Projects, Snakes & Ladders is the education and experience journey (playable), the trophy shelf holds certificates, the TV plays the promo video and the phone is the contact form. Chotu, the snake, is the chatbot.
